news.title: New Refreshed ISO Release – Updated Debian and Zyphor OS Packages
news.author: Mark Jason P. Espelita
news.summary: A refreshed Zyphor OS ISO is now available, featuring updated Debian packages and Zyphor OS components to provide a more up-to-date installation experience for new users and testers.
content: We are releasing a refreshed ISO of Zyphor OS 2 'Ada Lovelace' LTS Reforged and Zyphor OS 3 'Bethany' LTS, bringing updated Debian packages and Zyphor OS components together in a new installation image. This refresh aims to provide users with a more up-to-date system right from installation.

The updated ISO incorporates newer available packages and improvements to the Zyphor OS package collection, helping keep the system aligned with ongoing development. Keeping installation media refreshed is an important part of maintaining a reliable and convenient experience for users who are installing or testing Zyphor OS.
For new installations, we recommend using the latest available ISO rather than an older image, so you can start with the most recent package updates and system improvements included in this release.

Existing users do not necessarily need to reinstall their systems to benefit from package updates. Depending on the packages and improvements included, they can update their installed systems through the appropriate package management tools and configured Zyphor OS repositories.

As always, we encourage testers to try the refreshed ISO in a virtual machine before installing it on physical hardware. Please report any installation issues, hardware compatibility problems, or unexpected behavior so we can continue improving the system.

Thank you to everyone supporting Zyphor OS through testing, feedback, bug reports, and contributions. Every update brings us another step forward in building a dependable, community-driven Linux-based operating system.

news.title: New Zyphor OS News Page
news.author: Mark Jason P. Espelita
news.summary: Stay updated with the latest Zyphor OS releases, development progress, announcements, and community news through our new dedicated news page.
content: We are introducing the new Zyphor OS News Page, a dedicated place where our community can stay informed about the latest developments across the project. From new releases and system improvements to application updates and important announcements, this page will help keep everyone connected with the progress of Zyphor OS.

As a community-driven, Linux-based operating system, Zyphor OS continues to evolve through ongoing development, testing, bug fixes, documentation improvements, and contributions from our community. We believe that keeping users informed is an important part of building a reliable and accessible operating system for everyone.
Through this news page, we will share release announcements, new features, development milestones, known issues, testing opportunities, and other updates that matter to our users and contributors.
Whether you are a long-time user, a new tester, a developer, or simply curious about Zyphor OS, we invite you to follow our updates and join us as the project continues to grow.

Thank you to everyone who supports Zyphor OS, reports bugs, shares feedback, contributes improvements, and helps make the project better. Every contribution and piece of feedback helps us move forward.

news.title: Zyphor OS 3 "Bethany" LTS: zyphor-cli v4.0.1-r9-alpha has been released with a patch for Android Studio!
news.author: Mark Jason P. Espelita
news.summary: Zyphor OS 3 "Bethany" LTS: zyphor-cli v4.0.1-r9-alpha is out with an Android Studio patch. The setup now creates a proper launcher in your app menu and on the Desktop, and undo cleans it up.
content: Zyphor OS 3 "Bethany" LTS: zyphor-cli v4.0.1-r9-alpha has been released with a patch for Android Studio! `zyphor setup dev android-studio` now adds an Android Studio launcher to your app menu and Desktop, and `zyphor setup dev undo android-studio` removes it again. Update to get the fix: `sudo zy system upgrade`.
